text:
sam: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: customer wins/losses. Use this thread for short clarifying Qs and follow-ups. TL;DR: wins = Dedicated latency SLAs, predictable cost reports, reliability; losses = compliance timelines, missing SAML/SSO for Private, per-route throttling. Post short items and tag owners.
marta: Please share wins by vertical (SaaS, fintech, healthcare) even ballpark.
josh: Sales: 2 closes this quarter cited Dedicated SLA; 1 loss due to compliance timeline. Top asks: FedRAMP roadmap, SSO/SAML, longer log retention.
li: Eng: FedRAMP ~6 months with a dedicated squad; SAML/SCIM MVP ~8 weeks if prioritized. Need budget & prioritization.
devon: Support: recurring ask for per-route throttles and clearer quota alerts. Console per-route cost/latency would cut tickets.
kelly: Growth: Acme approved a case study verbally; need legal/comms signoff. Also want a one-pager "why we won" for sales.
marta: Product: will compile top 3 asks (SSO, FedRAMP, logs) and mark paid vs free + owners. First pass tomorrow AM.
sam: Leadership: SSO = high priority for Private (Q2 target MVP). FedRAMP funded but realistic ETA Q4. Log retention/per-route metrics = medium priority; accelerate if tied to support cost savings.
josh: Can we offer a stopgap for FedRAMP customers (network isolation + contract language)?
li: Possible but must avoid compliance claims; Ops to document exact controls.
ops-bot: New doc created: https://internal.redwood/docs/all-hands/wins-losses-followup (editable: @marta,@li,@josh).
devon: Two customer quotes from tickets:
> "We switched to Redwood Dedicated because we finally hit consistent p95 under 120ms."
> "We couldn't onboard until SAML was supported — had to choose another vendor."
kelly: I'll draft the sales one-pager and drop it here for quick review.
marta: I'll add vertical breakdowns + ask matrix to the doc. Expect first pass by tomorrow AM.
sam: Thanks all. Leadership will review Marta's doc and come back with prioritization and budget decisions. Post any more short items and tag owners. :raised_hands:
